scope: Scope: F12 plan record under F12g, complete for this scope only. This file is not F12-I's own C1 and does not authorise F12-I construction, contraction, scheduling or scoring. It records the 16 registered LoRA roots and their verified layer-split evidence, the registered Astra and C4 split definitions and source requirements, the F12-I chain anchor, and the registered prices and ceiling.

The Astra and C4 construction hashes, eligibility and dependencies are not part of F12's C1. They are recorded wholly in F12-I's own C1 under docs/prereg/f12_manifests/f12i/, after F8a's C1 and the F8a.4 Astra qualification disposition. Failed Astra qualification drops that pair and is recorded as such; no replacement or purchase of the full bypasses it. These exclusions from this file do not exclude any requirement from F12-I's own C1/C2 or change F12-I conditions 8–10.
